models.description:
# Model Summary

Predicts monthly and annual temperature anomalies by country using FAOSTAT panel data spanning 1961-2023. Trained on 240K observations across 247 territories with LightGBM regression, handling missing target values via row removal and categorical features natively. Intended for climate trend analysis, gap-filling missing temperature records, and baseline anomaly forecasting at national scale.

# Model Characteristics

- **Algorithm:** lightgbm_regressor
- **Problem type:** regression
- **Target column:** Value
- **Training samples:** 231,633
- **Features:** 7

# Data Overview

Trained on the Kaggle dataset [sevgisarac/temperature-change](https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/sevgisarac/temperature-change). Drop rows where Value is missing (3.4% of target). Encode Area, Months, and Flag as categorical (LightGBM native). Parse Year as datetime anchor (e.g., Jan 1 of each year) and derive cyclical features (sin/cos of year fraction). Months contains 17 categories (annual + 12 months + 4 seasons) -- treat as ordinal where logical or one-hot. No scaling needed for tree-based model.

**Feature columns used:** Area, Months, Year, Flag, Area Code (M49), Months Code, Year Code

# Evaluation Results

Evaluated via 5-fold cross-validation, compared against a naive baseline.

| | Model | Baseline |
|---|---|---|
| RMSE (mean) | 0.7563 | 1.0574 |
| RMSE (std) | 0.0063 | 0.0059 |

Metric direction: lower is better.
